name: DAAN RT-DETR paired source-only bias warmup diagnostic
objective: Compare only bias warmup learning rate on the same GPU and source training subset. This is an in-sample optimization diagnostic, not a transfer evaluation.

design.subset: Exact first 32 DAAN training frames used in diagnostic-rtdetr-DAAN-s0, overfit=True; train and score on these same frames. Freeze ordered IDs and hash labels and images before runs.
design.device: Same physical GPU on COCESR 1034, RTX A5000 preferred, identical software and backend flags; record GPU UUID and versions.
design.initialization: Pretrained RT-DETR-L, one-class train model restored from identical serialized post-construction state for all four fits. Confirm identical per-tensor digest immediately before first update; verify optimizer parameter groups.
design.paired_randomness: For each seed, same data order, augmentations and RNG/backend settings across arms; save ordered frame batches and comparable RNG evidence. Seeds 0 and 1 characterize data-order/randomness conditional on fixed initialized state.

training.recipe: Use corrected RT-DETR DAAN overfit worker and resolved job settings, explicitly differing only in warmup_bias_lr between arms.
training.early_stopping: Disable equally across all arms to guarantee 42 completed epochs. Stop explicitly after epoch 42; do not set epochs=42 because it changes cosine schedule. Abort on nonfinite values or hardware/runtime failure and retain evidence.
training.other_parameters: Use and record fully resolved worker defaults, package and backend versions, gradient accumulation, normalization, precision, and optimizer groups. Preflight must compare full resolved arguments with sole intended training difference warmup_bias_lr.

measurement.common_evaluation: Same fixed subset and evaluation at the end of every epoch including epoch 42; framework AP50 and AP50:95. Save raw per-epoch metrics; no threshold or hyperparameter tuning.
capture: per-step actual group learning rates and optimizer step indices, including initial bias rate and warmup duration
per-batch and epoch losses; nonfinite values or any termination failure
initial state tensor digests, pretrained weight digest, data/image/label/order digest, RNG seed
GPU UUID and model, runtime versions and exact resolved settings
checkpoints at epoch 42 and logs, times, exit codes
measurement.analysis: For each seed, report paired differences at epoch 42 and trajectories; disclose failures and report both arms and both seeds. Two seeds are descriptive; this cannot isolate historical initialization or support cross-site generalization claims.

historical_context.prior_failure: COCESR 1034 diagnostic-rtdetr-DAAN-s0/1, A5000; epoch 42 AP50 and AP50:95 zero with finite losses.
historical_context.prior_corrected: COMECH 2422 diagnostic-rtdetr-DAAN-s0/2, RTX 6000 Ada; epoch 42 AP50 86.65%, AP50:95 76.17%. Hardware changed, confounding prior contrast.
